notes.frame: Phosphor's shopping-cart (0.10 % of its ink uncovered at regular before the cut; its centerlines are the same in every line weight) without the basket's top edge, so the basket is open and user-plus's plus (48 units) drops into it, centred between the pole and the basket's right side. In bold 12 units stay clear above the basket bottom.
notes.fill: shopping-cart-fill (basket solid, wheels as rings) with the plus cut out at the basket's centre (140, 104): a solid basket can't be open, so fill shows the plus in the basket the way chat-plus-fill cuts its glyph. Duotone tints shopping-cart-duotone's basket area; the plus pokes above the tint.
